_doc: Registry nodes that are the same person as another node. Key = the duplicate slug, value = the slug to use. Both nodes stay in rabbi-places.json / rabbi-hierarchy.json (cached content still references the duplicates); the resolver folds candidates onto the value so a homonym pick never splits between two nodes for one person. Evidence (2026-09-17): the value slugs are live Sefaria topics with tagged refs (Rabbah 1,480; Rabbi Yehoshua 1,437; Rabbi Shmuel b. Nahmani 335); the key slugs have no Sefaria topic. In the Shas-wide Jev run the model split its probability across each pair (Rabbah 397 times). NOT duplicates, checked by bio: rabbi-oshaya (R. Oshaya Rabbah, student of R. Chiyya) vs rabbi-oshaya-2 (the later amora, brother of R. Chanina); rabbi-yishmael-b-elisha (the tanna) vs rabbi-yishmael-b-elisha-2 (the High Priest).
